candidate_name: Vlora Integrated Energy Hub (LNG terminal + Vlora TPP gas conversion + Fier-Vlora pipeline)
sponsor_or_proposer: Aktor Energy USA / Aktor LNG USA; Venture Global; Atlantic SEE LNG Trade (JV: Aktor Group 60% / DEPA Commercial (Greece))
current_state: Feasibility/commercial-supply stage MOUs (Feb-Apr 2026 reporting) at the SAME Vlora site as the now-cancelled Excelerate/ExxonMobil Port of Vlora FSRU (T100000130924, dedup_index.py match: score 0.455, 0.0km, dead-and-revived flag). Proposal bundles an LNG import terminal, conversion of the existing Vlora thermal power plant to gas, and a new Fier-Vlora pipeline linking to TAP. Initial gas supply reportedly routed via Greece before any dedicated Vlora import terminal is built.
missing_threshold_elements: No terminal-specific nameplate capacity figure found (only a general ~1 bcm/yr gas supply volume for the wider hub); power-plant capacity cited inconsistently across sources (~380 MW vs ~250 MW); no FID, no permit filing, no confirmed site/berth specification for the LNG component distinct from the power-plant conversion.
watch_for: A terminal-specific capacity figure, an FID/permit filing, or an EIA submission naming the LNG import component distinctly from the power-plant conversion; confirmation of whether this reuses the original Vlora FSRU site/berth or a different location.
notes: Different sponsor group from the original Excelerate/ExxonMobil Vlora project (now staged as cancelled in the update pass) -- per the dead-and-revived lifecycle rule, a materially different sponsor/design at a dead site is a NEW-terminal candidate, not a revival of T100000130924. However, given the ambiguity on terminal-specific capacity and the early (MOU/feasibility) stage, this is routed to monitor_list with escalation flagged rather than staged as new_terminal this cycle -- resolve scope/threshold doubt before staging, not after (CLAUDE.md escalation trigger: 'sufficient information to add' genuinely ambiguous).
